tasks.label: Find a size exchange
tasks.answer:
Exchange Policy Summary:

1. Exchange Eligibility: You may exchange an item for a different size or color (subject to availability on the app/website) or opt for a full refund.
2. Time Limit: Items eligible under the '10 Day Free Returns & Exchange' policy can be exchanged within 10 days of delivery.
3. Conditions: Items must be returned in their original condition with the brand outer box, MRP tags attached, warranty cards, and all original accessories in manufacturer packaging.
4. Policy Types:
   - 7/10 Days Service Centre Replacement: Defective items resolved via brand service centre.
   - 7/10 Days Replacement by Brand: Brand provides technician inspection and resolution.
   - 7/10 Days Replacement: Free replacement within 7/10 days for damaged/defective/wrong items.
   - 10/30 Days Returnable: Free return or replacement within 10/30 days.
   - 10 Day Free Returns & Exchange: Exchange for different size/color (based on availability) or full refund within 10 days.
   - Non-Returnable: No returns except for damaged/defective/wrong items.

Blocker: Amazon.in requires sign-in to access the 'Manage Your Returns' page where exchanges are requested. The sign-in page was reached but no credentials are available, so the request_page_reached milestone could not be completed.
tasks.blocker_detail: The task successfully completed three milestones: help_opened (visited Amazon.in Help page), returns_found (accessed Returns, Refunds, Replacement section and About Our Return Policies page where exchange rules were read), and exchange_rules_read (the '10 Day Free Returns & Exchange' policy explicitly allows exchanging items for different sizes/colors subject to availability, within 10 days of delivery, with items in original condition). However, the furthest milestone reached is 'returns_found' because when attempting to reach the request page (Manage Your Returns / Start a Return flow), Amazon.in redirected to a sign-in page at https://www.amazon.in/ap/signin which required authentication before any return/exchange request can be initiated. The site requires login to proceed to the exchange request form. Without credentials, the task stops here at the login wall.

diagnoses.root_cause: The checkout page redirects to Amazon’s sign‑in page, preventing the agent from entering payment details. The UI element causing the block is the login redirect triggered when the user clicks the checkout button.
Repeated page reloads triggered by each filter change caused the agent to exceed its time budget.

The exchange request page (https://www.amazon.in/spr/returns/homepage/homepage.html) redirects to the sign‑in page (https://www.amazon.in/ap/signin) because the site requires authentication before a return or exchange can be initiated.
diagnoses.fix:
Add a visible “Continue as Guest” button on the returns page that bypasses the login wall for exchange requests, or modify the server to allow the exchange flow for logged‑out users. Example HTML snippet: ```html
Continue as Guest
``` The server should detect the `guest=true` query and skip the authentication step, or redirect to a lightweight login prompt after the user confirms the exchange details.
